name: shotgun_metagenomics_to_mag
display_name: Shotgun Metagenomics → Assembly → CONCOCT Binning → Taxonomy
description: Standard shotgun metagenomics pipeline producing metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs): contig binning with CONCOCT, taxonomy assignment via MMseqs2, then differential abundance analysis across conditions using PathoStat for statistical microbiome analysis.
example_queries: shotgun metagenomics with CONCOCT binning and taxonomy
metagenome assembled genomes from shotgun sequencing
MAG recovery with binning and taxonomy assignment
metagenomics differential abundance analysis across conditions
